label: 24–30 October
notes: Cook in this order: fish and prawns go first while they're freshest.
Everything with fish or meat is from the fresh range, not frozen.
Freeze the leftover 250g of beef mince.
Protein figures are estimates per person.

dinners.title: Lemon-garlic sea bass with crushed potatoes & tenderstem
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 min, until tender. Add the tenderstem for the last 3 min, then drain.
Mix ½ tbsp oil with the lemon zest, garlic, paprika and a pinch of salt. Rub it over the sea bass.
Air fry the fillets skin-side up at 200°C for 7 min, until the skin crisps and the flesh flakes.
Lightly crush the potatoes with the rest of the oil and half the lemon juice. Season.
Serve the fish on the potatoes with the tenderstem, and squeeze over the rest of the lemon.
dinners.tip: Pat the skin really dry before it goes in. That's what makes it crisp.

dinners.title: Prawn & egg fried rice
steps: Cook the rice for 11 min, drain, then spread it on a plate to steam dry.
Heat the oil in a wok until very hot. Scramble the eggs for 1 min, then tip them out.
Stir-fry the pepper and tenderstem for 3 min. Add the ginger, garlic and prawns and cook for 3 min, until the prawns are pink.
Add the rice and tamari and toss over a high heat for 2 min.
Fold the egg back in, scatter with spring onions and serve.
dinners.tip: Dry rice fries; wet rice steams. Spreading it out for a few minutes makes the difference.

dinners.title: Chicken fajita rice bowls with black beans
steps: Put the rice on (11 min).
Toss the chicken with the paprika, cumin, oregano, a pinch of salt and the juice of 1 lime.
Fry the chicken in the oil on a high heat for 6–7 min, until cooked through. Add the peppers and onion for the last 4 min.
Warm the black beans in a small pan with a splash of water and a pinch of salt.
Build the bowls: rice, beans, chicken and veg, a spoon of yoghurt, and lime wedges.
dinners.tip: Slice the chicken thin so it cooks fast and picks up colour.

dinners.title: Beef & sweet potato hash with a fried egg

ingredients.item: lean beef steak mince 5% (from the 750g pack)

steps: Microwave the sweet potato cubes in a covered bowl with a splash of water for 5 min, until just soft.
Brown the mince in a large pan on a high heat for 6 min, breaking it up. Tip it out.
Add the oil and sweet potato and fry for 6–8 min, pressing down, until crisp at the edges.
Return the beef with the spices and spring onions and cook for 2 min. Season.
Fry the eggs in a corner of the pan or a separate pan, and serve on top with the chilli flakes.
dinners.tip: Freeze the 250g of mince you don't use. It's enough for a quick lunch.

dinners.title: Turkey meatballs in tomato & courgette sauce
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, half the garlic, half the oregano and a good pinch of salt. Roll into 16 balls.
Air fry at 200°C for 12 min, shaking halfway.
Meanwhile, put the rice on. Soften the onion and courgette in the oil for 5 min. Add the rest of the garlic and oregano.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 min until thick. Season.
Drop the meatballs into the sauce, simmer for 2 min, and serve over the rice.
dinners.tip: Wet your hands before rolling. The mixture is sticky.

dinners.title: Pork steaks with roast apple, potatoes & green beans

ingredients.item: Pink Lady apple, cut in wedges

steps: Toss the potatoes with ½ tbsp oil and salt. Air fry at 200°C for 12 min.
Rub the pork with the rest of the oil, the paprika, salt and pepper.
Shake the potatoes, add the pork and apple wedges, and air fry for 10–12 min more, turning the pork halfway. It's done at 63°C, or when the juices run clear.
Boil the green beans for 4 min, then drain.
Drizzle the honey over the apples and serve everything together.
dinners.tip: Rest the pork for 3 min before slicing so it stays juicy.

dinners.title: Halloumi & chickpea traybake
steps: Toss the chickpeas, pepper, courgette and onion with the oil, cumin, oregano and salt.
Air fry at 200°C for 12 min, shaking halfway.
Add the halloumi and tomatoes and cook for 8 min more, until the halloumi is golden and the tomatoes burst.
Season with pepper and serve.
dinners.tip: Halloumi is salty, so go light on salt for the veg.
